-module(creation_boundary_probe).
-export([run/2]).

run(Case, Output) ->
    put(output, Output),
    false = erlang:is_alive(),
    nonode@nohost = node(),
    {Requested, RetainedCreation} = inputs(Case),
    Node = creation_boundary@localhost,
    {Kernel, Monitor} = spawn_monitor(fun kernel/0),
    true = register(net_kernel, Kernel),
    try
        Retained = retained(Node, RetainedCreation),
        term("inputs", {Case, Node, Requested, RetainedCreation}),
        term("runtime-profile", {erlang:system_info(wordsize), erlang:system_info(build_type),
                                 erlang:system_info(system_architecture)}),
        term("before", {node(), erlang:system_info(creation), erlang:is_alive()}),
        term("retained-before", Retained),
        term("call-outcome", outcome(fun() -> erlang:setnode(Node, Requested) end)),
        term("active", {node(), erlang:system_info(creation), erlang:is_alive()}),
        term("owner-after", self()),
        %% This later use keeps the external identifier alive throughout selection.
        term("retained-after", Retained),
        exit(Kernel, kill),
        receive {'DOWN', Monitor, process, Kernel, DownReason} ->
            term("kernel-down", DownReason)
        after 5000 -> error(kernel_down_timeout) end,
        wait_inactive(500),
        term("inactive", {node(), erlang:system_info(creation), erlang:is_alive()}),
        save("stage", <<"complete">>),
        ok
    after
        exit(Kernel, kill)
    end.

inputs(truncated_zero) -> {1 bsl 32, none};
inputs(truncated_one) -> {(1 bsl 32) + 1, none};
inputs(maximum_small) -> {(1 bsl 59) - 1, none};
inputs(first_big) -> {1 bsl 59, none};
inputs(retained_four) -> {1 bsl 32, 4};
inputs(retained_max_wrap) -> {(1 bsl 59) - 1, (1 bsl 32) - 1}.

retained(_Node, none) -> none;
retained(Node, Creation) ->
    <<131, NodeTerm/binary>> = term_to_binary(Node),
    binary_to_term(<<131, 90, 3:16, NodeTerm/binary, Creation:32, 173:32, 29:32, 53:32>>).

kernel() -> receive stop -> ok end.

wait_inactive(0) -> error(kernel_inactive_timeout);
wait_inactive(Remaining) ->
    case erlang:is_alive() of
        false -> ok;
        true -> receive after 10 -> wait_inactive(Remaining - 1) end
    end.

outcome(Fun) ->
    try {result, Fun()}
    catch CallClass:CallReason:CallStack -> {exception, CallClass, CallReason, CallStack}
    end.

term(Name, Value) -> save(Name ++ ".etf", term_to_binary(Value)).
save(Name, Bytes) -> ok = file:write_file(filename:join(get(output), Name), Bytes).

# Original creation boundary observations

This additive standalone collector compiles one exact Erlang probe and runs six independent fresh unnamed OTP VMs after a separate runtime-attestation VM. Inputs cover positive SMALL truncation above32 bits, maximum SMALL, first BIG rejection, retained external4 collision and uintMax collision wrap. It records actual native outcome/state/creation without SDK expected values or normalization. The retained identifier is used after selection to preserve its lifetime.

The raw plan/probe hashes, source-build receipt/log hash, installed OTP_VERSION/root, pinned SourceTag/commit and case/artifact inventories are checked before any output writes. Entire probe failures retain full {Class,Reason,Stack}; child streams remain raw byte files with exit/timeout/drain state. Each independent case is attempted after another case reports incomplete or throws a collector-capture exception; that exception remains a failure and is separately recorded with unknown process fields left null. Runtime-attestation/compilation prerequisite failures stop scenario execution.

The workflow performs one exact pinned OTP29.1.1 source build for six scenario VMs and always uploads evidence. The published274 three probes/raw plan and all31 required captured observations remain immutable. This is a new observer version, never a retry or reinterpretation of274. Capture completeness alone is not semantic agreement.

The scoped artifact collector built with zero errors/warnings; twelve actual pre-write refusal cases passed. A helper directly invoked NodeProcess.Run in this artifact DLL: non-UTF-8 stdout/stderr bytes and child exit3 were exact, inherited pipes were bounded and the owned holding child terminated. Initial exporter style failure and initial build closure are preserved; one quoted-token-exact formatting correction yields style0. These are synthetic capture/refusal checks, not genuine OTP outcomes. The Main tool path has not yet been imported or executed. Publication still requires exact source/rawplan binary Git attributes and a fresh original workflow dispatch against the published head. Per-case wordsize/build_type/architecture are raw captures only; the collector does not enforce LP64, and the subsequent typed native guard must establish that profile before applying LP64 creation conclusions. Public-six option variants and physical nonempty queue accounting require separate observations.

name: Pinned OTP creation boundary observations
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  fixtures:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v6
        with:
          global-json-file: global.json
      - name: Build standalone creation boundary observation tool
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p artifacts
          dotnet build tools/Erlang.NodeCreationContrasts -m:1 --disable-build-servers 2>&1 | tee artifacts/beam-fixture-tool-build.log
      - name: Build and attest the pinned original OTP compiler
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          {
            echo "PINNED_BEAM_SOURCE_BEGIN $GITHUB_SHA"
            git clone --depth 1 --branch OTP-29.1.1 https://github.com/erlang/otp.git artifacts/beam-otp-source
            source_commit="$(git -C artifacts/beam-otp-source rev-parse HEAD)"
            test "$source_commit" = ad05823719d77c8faee87348ea39513d4e2f99c5
            echo "PINNED_BEAM_SOURCE_VERIFIED $source_commit"
            cd artifacts/beam-otp-source
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_CONFIGURE --without-javac --without-wx --without-odbc --without-debugger --without-observer --without-et'
            ./configure --prefix="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/beam-otp-oracle" --without-javac --without-wx --without-odbc --without-debugger --without-observer --without-et
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_MAKE -j2'
            make -j2
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_INSTALL'
            make install
            test "$(cat "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang/releases/29/OTP_VERSION")" = 29.1.1
            echo 'PINNED_BEAM_INSTALL_VERIFIED 29.1.1'
          } 2>&1 | tee artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import hashlib, json, os, pathlib
          root = pathlib.Path(os.environ['GITHUB_WORKSPACE'])
          log = root / 'artifacts/beam-otp-build.log'
          evidence = {
              'SourceCommit': 'ad05823719d77c8faee87348ea39513d4e2f99c5',
              'SourceTag': 'OTP-29.1.1',
              'SourceBuildCompleted': True,
              'InstalledOtpRoot': str(root / 'artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang'),
              'SourceBuildLog': str(log),
              'SourceBuildLogSha256': hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest().upper(),
              'HarnessCommit': os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],
              'RunId': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'],
              'RunAttempt': os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT'],
              'Job': os.environ['GITHUB_JOB'],
              'RunnerOs': os.environ['RUNNER_OS'],
              'ConfigureOptions': ['--without-javac','--without-wx','--without-odbc','--without-debugger','--without-observer','--without-et'],
              'BuildArguments': ['make','-j2'],
              'InstallArguments': ['make','install']
          }
          (root / 'artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json').write_text(json.dumps(evidence, indent=2) + '\n')
          PY
      - name: Capture six original creation cases in separate fresh VMs
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          dotnet run --project tools/Erlang.NodeCreationContrasts --no-build -- artifacts/beam-otp-oracle/lib/erlang artifacts/node-creation-boundaries artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: pinned-node-creation-boundaries
          path: |
            artifacts/node-creation-boundaries
            artifacts/beam-otp-build.log
            artifacts/beam-source-build-evidence.json
            artifacts/beam-fixture-tool-build.log
